1. Departed devices remain in kept results ✓ Resolved Medium
>
>Resolution reason >
> >
>Replay of kept retry and nomatch results is now conditioned on every device they name still being in
>the room (via namesOnlyHere and the here() helper using s.peers and own id), so results naming
>departed devices are dropped and cannot stop a push's wait; a regression test covers this.
>
>
>
>Description >
> >
>validResult rechecks current room membership for cached joined messages, but its retry and
>nomatch validators only check payload shape. If another device named by a kept result leaves
>before the sender takes over, replay still emits that result; a retry naming a local push can also
>cancel its pending no-match timer.
>
